title: Export existing left and right hand fingerings
scope: Emit supported public fingering values including explicit zero-valued thumb/open markers.
acceptance: Use different left/right fingerings and distinguish authored Thumb, Open and absence.

reproduction.instructions: Reproduce via the public Go parser and GP8 exporter, then load original and output with pinned AlphaTab. The observed end-to-end difference alone does not locate the failing stage.

evidence.detail: Imports exact P/I/M/A/C tokens into independent left and right public fields with authored-presence markers.
Exports Thumb through Little as exact P/I/M/A/C tokens while preserving the legacy nonzero-value fallback.
Covers distinct hands, every representable value, presence compatibility, absence, Open omission, exact wire output, reimport, strict policy, and invalid source values.
Pinned AlphaTab verifies all fingering facts in the GP7 effects fixture before and after Go GP8 export.
Reproduced at tracks[0].staves[0].bars[23].voices[0].beats[0].notes[0].leftHandFinger. Source and target values are stored in probe_comparison.

Checked independent left/right Thumb through Little, presence markers distinguishing authored Thumb from absence, Open-specific loss, exact GP8 names, validation, ownership, and pinned consumer preservation. Authored Open remains distinguished in the model and precisely omitted under GP8; strict export refuses that unsupported slice.

resolution: GPIF note import and GP8 export now preserve independent left- and right-hand Thumb, Index, Middle, Annular, and Little fingerings as P, I, M, A, and C. Existing HasLeftHandFinger and HasRightHandFinger markers distinguish an authored zero-valued Thumb or Open value from absence, while nonzero values retain their compatibility fallback without a marker. Explicit Open remains a narrow target omission because GPIF has no note-level Open/NoOrDead spelling; strict export succeeds without a fingering report for every representable value and rejects only that explicit omission. Unknown GPIF tokens receive side-specific diagnostics. M11-FINGERING covers exact wire values, reimport, absence, the Open target limit, strict policy, and source diagnostics, with a serialization mutant. Pinned AlphaTab preserves the full GP7 effects fingering fact set. The 364-fixture probe moves the eight exact GP6/GP7 fingering fixtures to equal-nondefault, preserves representable values in GP4/GP5 while leaving their authored Open values different, and leaves one authored Open in notation-legend as the only GP7 difference. The left/right omission reports drop from ten occurrences per binary fixture to five per side, matching only Open values. Generic unknown-element diagnostics drop only for newly recognized LeftFingering and RightFingering elements. No unrelated capability comparison changes. Chord diagram fingerings, hammer effects, rendering, and playback remain outside this change.
